title: Explore Florida household income by county
text:
Click a county on the map to see its median household income estimates from 2010 through 2023. The first chart shows Collier County.


Warning: sf layer has inconsistent datum (+proj=longlat +datum=NAD83 +no_defs).
Need '+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84'












The map colors show 2023 estimates. Each point is an ACS 5-year estimate, so neighboring points use overlapping years. Values are not adjusted for inflation. The downloaded data also includes each estimate’s margin of error.

title: About
text: This site uses the U.S. Census Bureau’s American Community Survey (ACS) 5-year estimates to explore median household income in Florida’s counties. The series runs from 2010 through 2023; dollar values are not adjusted for inflation, and the 5-year estimates overlap.

title: About
text:
Reproduce the analysis
The download step is separate from the website:

Configure your Census API key for tidycensus in your local R environment. Do not save the key in this repository.
Run Rscript data-raw/download_income.R to create the county income CSV and map geometry in data/.
Run quarto render to rebuild the website. index.qmd reads those files to draw the map and interactive chart.

The downloader requests ACS table B19013 (median household income) for all Florida counties. The margin of error is included in the CSV; the map colors use the latest estimate, 2023.
